title: Enforcement Decree of the Act on Special Rural Development Tax
full_text:
Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Decree is to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on Special Rural Development Tax and matters necessary for its enforcement. <Amended 2005.12.31>

Article 2 (Definitions) Terms used in this Decree have the meanings prescribed by the Act on Special Rural Development Tax (hereinafter referred to as the "Act"). <Amended 2005.12.31>

Article 3 Deleted. <1994.12.31>

Article 4 (Non-Taxation)
(1) "Prescribed by Presidential Decree" in Article 4(2) of the Act means a reduction or exemption falling under any of the following subparagraphs. <Amended 1994.12.23, 1994.12.31, 1995.12.30, 1997.10.1, 1997.12.31, 1998.12.31, 1999.12.31, 2000.12.29, 2001.12.31, 2002.12.30, 2003.12.30, 2005.12.31, 2008.2.29, 2010.9.20, 2010.12.30, 2013.3.23, 2014.11.19, 2015.2.27, 2016.2.5, 2017.7.26, 2019.2.12, 2025.2.28, 2025.12.30>
1. Reduction or exemption under Articles 66 through 70, Article 72(1) (excluding corporations under subparagraphs 1, 5, and 8), Article 77 [limited to land directly cultivated by a resident under the main text of Article 69(1) of the Restriction of Special Taxation Act (the requirement to cultivate for at least 8 years does not apply)], Articles 102 and 104-2 of the Restriction of Special Taxation Act, and Article 57-3(1)2 (limited to property acquired by a cooperative under the Agricultural Cooperatives Act) and 3 (limited to property acquired by a cooperative under the Fisheries Cooperatives Act) of the Restriction of Special Local Taxation Act;
2. Reduction or exemption under Article 93(1) of the Customs Act;
3. Reduction or exemption under Article 6(1), (2), and (4), Articles 7 through 9, Article 10(1), Articles 11 and 12, Article 14(1) through (3), and Article 14-3 of the Restriction of Special Local Taxation Act;
4. Local tax reductions or exemptions under ordinances under Article 4 of the Restriction of Special Local Taxation Act that are similar to those under subparagraphs 1 through 3 and publicly notified by the Minister of the Interior and Safety in consultation with the Minister of Finance and Economy.
(2) "Prescribed by Presidential Decree" in Article 4(6) of the Act means reduction or exemption under Articles 88 and 92, Article 93(4) through (7) and (9) through (14), Article 94, and Articles 96 through 101 of the Customs Act. <Amended 2010.12.30>
(3) "Securities market prescribed by Presidential Decree" in the proviso to Article 4(7) of the Act means the securities market under Article 176-9(1) of the Enforcement Decree of the Financial Investment Services and Capital Markets Act. <Newly inserted 2022.2.15>
(4) "Prescribed by Presidential Decree" in Article 4(8) of the Act means reduction or exemption under Article 4(4), Article 57-2(2) and (6), Article 66(1) and (2), Article 68(1) and (3) (limited to used motor vehicles acquired for export by persons engaging in trade under the Foreign Trade Act), Article 73(3), Article 74(4) and (5), and Article 92 of the Restriction of Special Local Taxation Act, and Article 9(3) through (5), Article 15(1)1 through 4 and 7, and Article 26(2)1 and 2 of the Local Tax Act. <Amended 2010.12.30, 2012.2.2, 2015.2.27, 2016.12.1, 2019.2.12, 2020.1.15, 2022.2.15>
(5) "Modest housing prescribed by Presidential Decree" in Article 4(9) and (11) of the Act means residential buildings not exceeding the size of national housing under Article 2(6) of the Housing Act (for multi-household houses under subparagraph 1(c) of attached Table 1 of the Enforcement Decree of the Building Act, based on the exclusive residential area per household) and their appurtenant land (including land acquired, developed, or supplied for construction of such housing by the State, a local government, or the Korea Land and Housing Corporation established under the Korea Land and Housing Corporation Act), within the area calculated by multiplying the housing floor area (for apartments, row houses, and other multi-family housing, the floor area partitioned so one household can independently occupy and use it) by the applicable multiplier for each use district in the following table. <Amended 2012.2.2, 2016.8.11, 2022.2.15>

| Category | Use district | Applicable multiplier |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Urban area | 1. Exclusive residential district | 5 times |
| Urban area | 2. Commercial district or semi-residential district | 3 times |
| Urban area | 3. General residential district or industrial district | 4 times |
| Urban area | 4. Green district | 7 times |
| Urban area | 5. Unplanned district | 4 times |
| Use districts outside urban areas | | 7 times |

(6) "Farmhouses prescribed by Presidential Decree" in Article 4(11) of the Act means residential buildings owned by persons engaged in farming for farming purposes and their appurtenant land, located in the same Si, Gun, or Gu (meaning an autonomous Gu; the same applies in this paragraph) as the farmland, or in an adjoining Si, Gun, or Gu: Provided, high-value houses under Article 156 of the Enforcement Decree of the Income Tax Act are excluded. <Amended 2000.12.29, 2005.12.31, 2010.12.30, 2015.2.27, 2022.2.15>
(7) "Prescribed by Presidential Decree" in Article 4(12) of the Act means the following reductions or exemptions. <Amended 1994.12.23, 1994.12.31, 1995.12.30, 1997.8.30, 1997.10.1, 1997.12.31, 1998.12.31, 1999.10.30, 1999.12.31, 2000.10.21, 2000.12.29, 2001.8.14, 2001.12.31, 2002.4.20, 2002.12.30, 2004.12.31, 2005.1.5, 2005.12.31, 2006.2.9, 2008.2.29, 2009.2.4, 2009.4.21, 2009.6.9, 2009.12.15, 2010.2.18, 2010.6.8, 2010.7.9, 2010.9.20, 2010.12.30, 2011.7.14, 2012.2.2, 2012.5.22, 2013.3.23, 2013.10.22, 2014.2.21, 2014.11.19, 2015.2.27, 2015.12.31, 2016.2.5, 2016.12.1, 2016.12.30, 2017.6.27, 2017.7.26, 2018.2.27, 2018.12.31, 2019.2.12, 2020.1.15, 2020.2.11, 2020.4.14, 2021.2.17, 2022.2.15, 2022.2.17, 2023.2.28, 2023.3.14, 2024.2.29, 2025.2.28, 2025.12.30>
1. Reduction or exemption under Articles 10, 10-2, 12, 12-2, 13, 14, 16-2, 18, 18-2, 18-3, 19(2), 29-6, 30, 30-3, 33, 63, 63-2, 64, 76(1), 92, 95-2, 98-3, 98-5, 99-9, 99-11, 104-8(1) and (3), 104-21, 104-24, 104-28, 104-31, 118-2, 121-2 through 121-4, 121-13, 126-2, 126-6, and 126-7(9) of the Restriction of Special Taxation Act;
1-2. Reduction of or exemption from acquisition tax or registration and license tax on registration for State property contributed in kind to the Korea Railroad Corporation established under the Korea Railroad Corporation Act;
1-3. Deleted. <2014.12.30>
1-4. Reduction or exemption under Article 57-2(3)1 of the Restriction of Special Local Taxation Act for the Korea Broadcast Advertising Corporation established under Article 24 of the Act on Broadcast Advertising Sales Agencies;
1-5. Deleted. <2014.12.30>
1-6. Reduction or exemption under Article 57-2(5)3 of the Restriction of Special Local Taxation Act for NongHyup Agribusiness Group Inc. or NongHyup Financial Group Inc. established under Article 161-2 or 161-10 of the Agricultural Cooperatives Act;
1-7. Reduction or exemption under Article 57-2(3)3 of the Restriction of Special Local Taxation Act where NongHyup Agribusiness Group Inc. receives the economic businesses of the National Agricultural Cooperative Federation by contribution in kind under Article 6 of the Addenda to the Act Partially Amending the Agricultural Cooperatives Act, Act No. 10522;
2. Exemption from acquisition tax under Articles 13(2)5 and 57-3(2) of the Restriction of Special Local Taxation Act where the Korea Asset Management Corporation under the Act on the Establishment of Korea Asset Management Corporation or the Korea Rural Community Corporation under the Korea Rural Community Corporation and Farmland Management Fund Act purchases previous real estate under Article 43 of the Special Act on the Creation and Development of Innovation Cities;
3. Reduction of or exemption from income tax on interest income from deposits at cooperatives and other institutions under Article 89-3 of the Restriction of Special Taxation Act granted to a person falling under any of the following items:
(a) A farmer or fisher under Article 2(1) of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on Savings for Preparing a Lump Sum of Money for Farming and Fishing Households;
(b) A forestry worker under Article 2 of the Enforcement Decree of the Forestry Cooperatives Act: Provided, a person owning at least 5 hectares of forest is excluded;
(c) An employee under Article 2(1)1 and 2 of the Enforcement Decree of the Korea Housing Finance Corporation Act;
4. Reduction or exemption under Article 90(1)2 through 4, Article 91, and Article 93(2), (3), and (15) of the Customs Act;
5. Reduction or exemption under Article 9(2) of the Local Tax Act and Article 13(2)1-2, Article 15(2), Article 16(1), Articles 17, 17-2, 19, and 20, Article 21(1), Article 22(1), (4), (7), and (8), Article 22-2(1) and (2), Articles 22-3 and 23, Article 28(1), Article 29, Article 30(3), Article 31(1) and (2), Article 31-3(1) and (2), Article 31-4, Article 33(1) and (2), Articles 34, 36, and 37, Article 38(1), Articles 40 and 40-3, Article 41(1), (5), and (7), Article 42(2) and (3), Article 43(1), Article 44(1), Article 44(2)1, Article 44(3), Article 44-2, Article 45(1), Article 45(2)1, Article 46, Article 50(1), Article 52(1) and (2), Article 53, Article 54(5), Article 57-2(1) (limited to mergers that meet the requirements in the subparagraphs of Article 44(2) of the Corporate Tax Act or fall under paragraph (3) of that Article and are treated as giving rise to no gain or loss on transfer), Article 57-2(3)2, Article 57-2(9), Article 58-2, Article 60(4), Article 63, Article 64(1), Article 66(3) and (4), Article 67(1) and (2), Article 72(1), Article 73(1), Article 73-2, Article 74(3), Article 74-2(1), Article 76(1), Articles 79 and 80, Article 81(1) and (2), Article 83(1) and (2), Article 85(1), Articles 85-2, 88, and 89, and Article 90(1) of the Restriction of Special Local Taxation Act;
6. Local tax reductions or exemptions under ordinances under Article 4 of the Restriction of Special Local Taxation Act that are similar to those in subparagraphs 1 through 5 and publicly notified by the Minister of the Interior and Safety in consultation with the Minister of Finance and Economy.
(8) Where transitional measures or special cases under Articles 13 through 19 of the Addenda to the Act Amending the Regulation of Tax Reduction and Exemption Act, Act No. 4666, apply to provisions of that Act granting reductions or exemptions with the same purpose as the corresponding provisions of the Restriction of Special Taxation Act specified in the Act or this Decree as exempt from special rural development tax, special rural development tax shall likewise not be imposed on those transitional measures or special cases. <Amended 1998.12.31, 2005.12.31, 2022.2.15>

Article 5 (Calculation of Tax Base)
(1) "Securities market prescribed by Presidential Decree" in the tax base column of Article 5(1)5 of the Act means the securities market under Article 176-9(1) of the Enforcement Decree of the Financial Investment Services and Capital Markets Act. <Newly inserted 2013.8.27>
(2) "Amount calculated by the calculation method prescribed by Presidential Decree" in Article 5(3) of the Act means the amount calculated by the following formula. <Amended 2010.12.30, 2013.8.27>
(Tax calculated by including non-taxable income and income deductions in the tax base) - (Tax calculated by excluding non-taxable income and income deductions from the tax base).
(3) Special rural development tax whose principal tax is individual consumption tax or securities transaction tax shall not be included in the tax base under the Individual Consumption Tax Act or Securities Transaction Tax Act. <Amended 2005.12.31, 2007.12.31, 2013.8.27>
(4) Where additional tax is added to the principal tax for failure to pay the principal tax, that additional tax shall not be included in the tax base for special rural development tax. <Amended 2013.8.27>
(5) In calculating the tax base for special rural development tax whose principal tax is individual consumption tax, for goods manufactured or processed using goods subject to special rural development tax as raw materials, the tax base shall be the individual consumption tax calculated on the manufactured or processed goods minus the individual consumption tax paid on those raw materials. <Amended 2007.12.31, 2013.8.27>

Article 6 (Returns and Payment)
(1) When special rural development tax is reported and paid under Article 7 of the Act, the return and payment form for the relevant principal tax shall separately state the amount of that principal tax, the amount of special rural development tax, and their total.
(2) Where an amended return and additional voluntary payment of special rural development tax are made under Articles 45 and 46 of the Framework Act on National Taxes, the deadline for the amended return, payment method, reduction of additional tax, and other matters shall follow the procedures for the relevant principal tax. <Amended 2005.12.31>

Article 7 (Assessment and Collection)
(1) When special rural development tax is assessed and collected under Article 8 of the Act, the payment notice for the relevant principal tax shall separately state the amount of that principal tax, the amount of special rural development tax, and their total.
(2) Where the mayor, head of a Gun, or head of an autonomous Gu (hereinafter referred to as "mayor or head of a Gun"), or head of a tax office, issues a notice for special rural development tax alone, the notice shall state the tax base for special rural development tax.

Article 8 (Payment in Installments)
Special rural development tax under Article 9(2) of the Act may be paid in installments within the installment payment period for the relevant principal tax as follows:
1. Where special rural development tax does not exceed 10 million won: the amount exceeding 5 million won;
2. Where special rural development tax exceeds 10 million won: an amount not exceeding 50/100 of that tax.

Article 9 Deleted. <2014.2.21>

Article 10 (Payment into the National Treasury)
(1) Special rural development tax collected by a mayor or head of a Gun shall be paid, together with a payment form, into the Bank of Korea (including an agent of the National Treasury; the same applies in this Article) or a postal office in accordance with procedures separately prescribed by the Minister of Finance and Economy in consultation with the Minister of the Interior and Safety. <Amended 1995.11.30, 1998.12.31, 2008.2.29, 2013.3.23, 2014.11.19, 2017.7.26, 2025.12.30>
(2) Where the treasury of a local government or its collection agent receives special rural development tax, it shall send the notice of receipt to the mayor or head of a Gun and pay the special rural development tax received directly into the National Treasury.
(3) Article 24(1) of the Enforcement Decree of the Local Tax Collection Act applies mutatis mutandis to special rural development tax imposed on local tax amounts. <Amended 2005.12.31, 2010.9.20, 2017.3.27>

Article 11 (Refunds)
(1) Where a mayor or head of a Gun refunds special rural development tax under Article 12 of the Act, an amount equivalent to the refund shall be appropriated from the revenues of the Si or Gun.
(2) Where an amount equivalent to a special rural development tax refund is to be appropriated from revenues of the Si or Gun under paragraph (1), measures shall be taken so that an amount equivalent to the refund, out of special rural development tax received by the treasury of the Si or Gun, is not paid into the National Treasury but becomes revenue of the treasury of the Si or Gun. Where an official of the Si or Gun collects special rural development tax, the official may pay an amount equivalent to the refund directly into the treasury of the Si or Gun.

Article 12 (Reporting on Assessment and Collection)
The mayor or head of a Gun shall report the monthly assessment and collection status of special rural development tax to the Minister of Finance and Economy by the 20th day of the following month. <Amended 1994.12.23, 1998.12.31, 2008.2.29, 2025.12.30>
